defect: The full assurance runner executed check-alias-contract-mutation.mjs but that checker was absent from the assurance-infrastructure content digest.
impact: Changing or weakening the alias mutation-kill checker itself did not change the reviewed assurance-infrastructure digest, so the proof harness was not fully source-bound.
fix: Bind the alias checker and AST-discover every scripts/*.mjs or scripts/*.cjs literal in run-assurance.mjs, failing closed when any invoked checker is absent from assuranceInfrastructureFiles.
mutationKill: check-assurance-infrastructure-binding-mutation.mjs rewrites an actual bound runner script literal to an unbound checker and requires the conformance gate to fail specifically for an unbound proof/checker script.
